channel.title: AI GridWatch — Connecticut data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Connecticut, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Morris: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year moratorium covering data centers and battery storage, passed unanimously by the PZC. Driven by farmland and rural character concerns

item.title: Approval of Connecticut tax credits for data center bypassed required review
Groton: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers over 5,000 sq ft; lapsed into permanent zoning in Jun 2023 capping buildings at 12,500 sq ft and barring water cooling

item.title: New Haven: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 12-month moratorium pitched; would bar city departments from accepting or approving data center applications or conversions
